CORRECTED — the MWScan/2020 `servepdf.php` endpoint is RIGHT (serves 1899); the 1872 first-edition scan coexists on the portal with colliding page numbers
Huet correspondence predates this session (2021) — the morphology-XML "gate" was already resolved in writing; direct download URLs recovered
Heritage vs kosha forms diff: the small raw overlap is mostly convention + model difference, and "disagreements" are two-thirds lemmatization policy, not error
The WIL etymology extraction's affix field is ~half noise — Wilson "outlier" figures are substantially a measurement artifact
DICO's entry anchors nest three structural roles under one HTML class — only one is a true entry boundary
`gen_opt_harness2.py` output-budget: coarser wins on both knobs, in opposite directions

Böhtlingk's *Indische Sprüche* (both editions) already fully digitized in `sanskrit-lexicon-scans`, not just `sanskrit-lexicon`
pwg_ru TM composite grade: A is consensus-gated (5.7%), and a reference-free surface QE cannot detect wrong-sense
The reverse dictionary's 30 sources split ~18 PD vs ~10 in-copyright — the merged headword list is not automatically publishable
PWG marks case government explicitly ≈3,853 times across ≈3,222 senses — a deterministic census, not an estimate
VedaWeb's `id_gra` token field IS the Grassmann `<L>` entry number — no fuzzy text-matching needed for a GRA↔VedaWeb crosswalk
VedaWeb 2.0's "CC BY 4.0 for everything" claim is not machine-confirmed — only 2/36 catalog resources carry an explicit license field
The ls-graph citation matrix is degenerate for MW — its top abbreviations sit unresolved; use the citation-apparatus siglum matrix for cross-dict citation profiles
The DCS `QL` frequency workbook's `SLP1` and length columns are truncated at ṣṭh/ḍh clusters
In PWG, article size dwarfs every "parametric" statistic you can extract from the entry
The Sanskrit spellchecker landscape: one dormant demo, one license-unsettled 543k wordlist, no occupant
Hand-transcribed telemetry cannot adjudicate code-vs-infra — and a local-only ledger silently swaps your denominator
The full Devībhāgavata-purāṇa Sanskrit is NOT on GRETIL — only the Devigita fragment; the complete mūla lives on sanskritdocuments.org without `DbhP_` markers
DCS 2026 sqlite carries 531,747 sense-annotated tokens (`m_wordsem`) but NO local ID→gloss inventory — gold-scored WSD against MW senses is blocked until the inventory is recovered
Amarakosha and SIL semdom both bolt a formal annex onto a semantic taxonomy — and it is the same ~10% once polysemy is set aside
DCS 2021→2026 "lost lemma" counts are mostly lemmatization-policy drift — a-privatives now resolve to their bases
DCS `text_sandhied` is largely DE-sandhied pada text in the Rāmāyaṇa — and locus joins fail across editions; a text-keyed 3-tier match (exact / consonant-skeleton / fuzzy) recovers it
vidyut-cheda 0.4 lemmatizes derivatives to the dhātu ROOT (rāmaḥ → ram) where DCS uses the nominal stem — and over-segments epic verse 1.44×
MW `<e>` encodes the 1899 print's headword typography (1 = Devanāgarī entry, 2 = roman-only, 3 = run-on compound; letter suffix = continuation record)
MW and the Petersburg dictionaries are NOT independent witnesses on inventory or apparatus — do not count their agreement as corroboration; but no shared *error* has ever been found
pwg_ru readiness audit: `[NWS:]` attribution and `{%…%}`-delimiter dropping are NOT audit-contract defects; observed token/cost economy is `not_recoverable`; store-membership ≠ audit-clean
The DCS snapshot's UD dependency slice is real but VEDIC-SKEWED — syntax studies get counterexample hunts, not classical norms
A curated DCS text→period map EXISTS (consume, don't rebuild) — and the purāṇas carry a measured epic-imitative signature on two independent axes
DCS verbal-feature annotation density collapses for later texts — feats-based diachronic metrics measure ANNOTATION, not language
A clean-looking subset is not promotable evidence when its audit or execution contract failed
Samāsa-type frequency does not exist in any org corpus — and the grammarians' canonical examples are corpus-ghosts (8/58 attested, max freq 147)
The roadmap's "OBS-T κ=0.42" was a phantom figure — no measured agreement exists for any OBS-T axis

MW writes `<ls>` citations in TWO markup shapes and locates them in roman as well as arabic — a literal `<ls>` regex undercounts its apparatus by 28.6%, and case-folding the roman test erases the `L.` hedge
A spelling-keyed join onto Whitney's roots union-smears homonyms — one authorial entry lands on every homonym of that spelling, and the rows still read `authorial`
DCS has no aorist TENSE value — `feat_tense='Past'` lumps aorist with the perfect; `feat_formation` is what actually separates them
A verified claim register is not Whitney-proof — 3 of 229 erdict_fact: TRUE rows in Kochergina claims.yml contradict Whitney, and ~65 of the register/article §-refs point at the wrong section
Declared, validated, and never enforced — the PWG headless executor read a manifest `budgets{}` block it did not obey, and every offline gate stayed green
kosha's generated `forms` is 93% DCS-derived, so its attested-form join is a round-trip — only the vidyut-engine subtotal (12.4% attested) carries signal, and A¬G cannot measure engine gaps
DharmaMitra `unsandhied` batches return MISALIGNED results on short inputs — doubled echoes and other texts' tokens — so every consumer must validate by surface reconstruction before display
SamudraManthanam's generated full-corpus JSONL has 38,288 duplicate canonical-ID groups, concentrated in `devibhagavata-purana`

Cross-dictionary attestation via Monier-Williams overstates independence — MW was compiled *from* Böhtlingk-Roth (PW/PWG), so an MW-only hit is not evidence a PW/PWG word is independently text-attested
Quantified: the §83/§97 witness-collapse deflates the published 15-dict union "corroboration" from 55.9% to 34.7% — and the union's own table is pre-fold

PD's inline sigla contain a near-homograph pair that similarity-clustering silently fuses — `MahāBhā.` is the Mahābhārata, `MahāBh.` is the Mahābhāṣya, and the locator shape tells them apart mechanically
Output gates must audit structured semantic fields, and sample-clean editorial rewrites still require a full-population ambiguity pass
DCS's compound dictionary carries splits whose member **order** does not match the surface form — invisible to a type-drill, fatal to any head-first analysis
`10.5281/zenodo.15834721` is a false DOI, cited as genuine in two different repos
The DCS `dcs-conllu` treebank is only ~3.9 % dependency-parsed — corpus government/valency work must lean on co-occurrence, not arcs, and read absence as "unknown"

MW's derivation markup and the DCS corpus are productive over the *same* compound final members but with near-disjoint first members (median Jaccard 0.00, 56% share zero) — and the corpus-unattested MW stratum is kośa/participle formations, not ghost-words

DCS covers ~25% of the Poona Dictionary's citation mass but ~78% of DCS's own tokens — the classical core, not PD's encyclopedic breadth; and a siglum prefix-merge fuses MahāBhā. (Mahābhārata) with MahāBh. (Mahābhāṣya)

A Sanskrit dictionary's big letters are big because they head *preverb families* — and testing "entries shrink over publication" needs an outlier-robust estimator, not a parametric regression (encyclopedic dicts have single 300k-char articles)

PWG's entry-size decay is a *smooth* funding/energy fade across its whole 20-year run (−14 %/decade), not a one-time correction after the over-detailed first volume — and SKD/VCP carry ~0 digitisation markup
"Gold" in this org means *frozen*, not *human-adjudicated* — 0 of 15 gold datasets have independent human annotation, and every travelling κ is model-vs-model (four contamination mechanisms)
The r2 kośa-fusion "separable" class is substantially an orthographic sandhi artifact — whether an SKD citation counts "fused" depends on whether the authority's name begins with a vowel
On Windows, repeated repository discovery can dominate a Python pipeline: cache checkout identity, not mutable path overrides
The pwg_ru store's `de` field is NOT a faithful copy of the csl-orig German — Russian connectives have been substituted into the source-of-truth string
The H1624 G1 `gloss_lang` classifier mislabels German as Latin/English about half the time it fires — and those spans are then withheld from translation
PWG sense × DCS attestation collapses from ~40% at lemma level to 0.67% at sense level — and three independent constrictions cause it
MW's `cf.` and PWG's `Vgl.` are NOT independent witnesses — they agree ~2,950× above chance, so a shared cross-reference never counts as double attestation

corpus_lexicon.jsonl gets its first intrinsic BLI quality number — and the obvious gold source (the corpus's own glossary) is circular, so the fix is an independent dictionary ranked by an independent frequency source
PWG's plain `R.` is a THREE-edition composite — books 3–6 carry Gorresio (Bengal-recension) numbering, so keying them into a Southern-recension text silently returns the wrong verse
`to_slp1` is case-preserving, so a capitalised IAST headword transliterates into a DIFFERENT SLP1 letter — 60% of NCC match-keys are wrong and 14,379 exact ACC×NCC matches were never proposed
The Cologne scan-viewer page PDFs can carry an embedded digitized text layer — check `get_text()` BEFORE declaring "no e-text exists" or commissioning OCR

A corpus-candidate matcher keyed on a dictionary's OWN bibliographic prose will bury its biggest wins in the "no corpus side exists" class — PWG's Pāṇini and Manu, 41,910 citations, sat in `DCS-LACKS`
Choosing a confidence tier ONCE PER SENSE and then stamping it on many passages inflates the strongest tier — 4.13% of H1670's exact-verse rows were chapter-level
OCR the canonical page files themselves — mapping a THIRD-PARTY OCR of "the same" scan onto them loses to offset drift, thumbnail decoys, and digit aliasing
PWG's etymology parenthesis is NESTED — a "first `+`-chain" regex reads the inner sub-analysis, not the compound's members
MW's `<k2>` carries a variant LIST after `;` and two different boundary marks — stripping the punctuation welds variants into a member that is not a word
Repairing an extractor GROWS the disagreement queue it feeds — plan for that, not for a shrink
35 cards is the floor for a 0.90 Wilson gate — and a censused stratum needs no interval at all
A blind arm stratified on an agent's own rules must not render the rule — and its card ids must come from the lock, not the frame
PWG's etymology parenthesis: "first `{#…#}` per `+`-part" is right until PWG writes a derivation ladder
A non-empty PDF text layer proves nothing — check the SCRIPT; and "extract the largest embedded image" breaks when the PDF CROPS a 2-up scan

A corpus file's PRESENCE is not evidence of its contents — `07_ramayana-uttarakanda.jsonl` is Sanskrit-only CRITICAL-edition text under a "Southern/Leonov" label, and a handoff was minted off the filename
A count column with no stated provenance is not data — it is a ranking, and the difference decides whether you may divide by it
A resolver that fails closed is a gap; one that fails *open* is a wrong answer — and only the second is an integrity defect
A quarter of the DCS nominal mass has no case at all — `feat_case='Cpd'` is a compound member, not a ninth case
The 2021-sourced "Nom.Sg = 34.6% of nominal forms, dual < 1% everywhere" does not reproduce on DCS-2026 — and the second half only survives read per cell
Before OCR-ing a library scan, check whether the library already published its OCR — and measure against it rather than guessing
A cross-scheme join is a transliteration step, not a string comparison — a naive IAST-to-SLP1 match selects on diacritics
DCS stem co-occurrence graph is extreme-sparse with function-word hubs
Sintagmatic appendix-6 is a 6.3k-lemma core nested in the 80k all-corpus table
Heritage×kosha form intersection agrees 78.3%; disagreements are classifiable
Verb-form frequency prelim is an unlabeled 42-row XLS with empty tense names
Stopovye is a 102-file subset of Polnorazmernye, not a stopword filter of the full 506k
Cross-vendor LLM second pass on routing gold is κ=1.0 — still not human IAA
Homonym token-attribution residual is a 38-group single-lemma_id ceiling
Cyrillic name indices: 61 IAST-bearing seed files vs 47 pure-Cyrillic — rules still unsafe
Edit-distance record linkage over Sanskrit headwords is 70–98 % false matches — use a length-preserving normalization key and measure the false-match rate against the dictionary's own inventory
The csl-orig L-number is not a join key — only 35 % of form-era L-codes still point at their own headword
Word-initial Harvard-Kyoto capitals never decode — 113 correction-event headwords entered the corpus mis-transcoded
Gold cards without evidence yield unusable votes — 5 of 6 MQM rejects carried no typology label, 1 of 20 labels reversed on adjudication
A batch that never runs deletes a *band* of the sample, not a random subset — byte-packed chunking makes an incomplete A/B silently flatter the arm that failed
A git worktree silently disables every sibling-repo lookup in `src/` — artifacts rebuilt there lose layers without failing
The NWS tag layer reaches only 2.2 % of the RU store — a facet bar over it is right, but it is not the sheet's main axis
An A/B whose "clean" metric scores the last attempt that RETURNED, not what the pipeline would ship, can name the wrong winner — and did
SamudraManthanam stores canonical line IDs but drops them from durable references — corpus rebuilds can silently retarget exports and corrections
A frozen local checkout is an actively misleading source for any append-only registry — read the numbering contract from `origin/`, not from disk
MW72 carries ZERO `<ls>` source citations — every cross-dictionary citation test that names it shrinks to MW
PWG rests on WIL 1819; MW/MW72 English on WIL 1832 — CDSL has only 1832 OCR; do not treat Wilson as edition-free
A later PR's stale-base merge can silently revert an EARLIER PR's ledger-doc-only re-stamp while leaving that earlier PR's CODE change fully intact
